acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Golems family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Stone Servant, T2, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Band-Brace Soldier (Soldier) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two fire construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Fieldstone body, iron bands, faint joint seams, blank slab face, and mature baseline proportions.
Signature mechanic: Band Brace: one iron binding locks while the opposite stone arm repeats a reliable shove.
battlefieldDuty: Hold a short front with fieldstone mass and alternating iron-bound joints.
constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1–T3 have no floating plates, no molten core, no gemstone, and no halo; T4 alone gains source-supported floating plates and a molten core; T5 alone gains a gemstone heart and rune-halo.
Added Fire construction uses external charcoal fuel grooves, heat-blackened bands, cycling furnace shutters, smoke vents, and cooling seams distinct from native animation light or the T4 source core.
counterplay: Strike the slack opposite band after the shove to separate two fieldstones. Affinity signal: Tier-safe anchors: T1–T3 have no floating plates, no molten core, no gemstone, and no halo, so a fuel groove exposes the joint rune; T4 floating plates expose its molten core shutter; T5 gemstone heart and rune-halo desynchronize at the cooling seam.
forbiddenTreatments: Calling native seam light Fire affinity
identityInvariants: Blocky heavy humanoid construction, oversized hands, small or absent head, blank carved face, and visible joint gaps remain legible.
Clay, fieldstone, iron banding, granite, basalt, marble, gold inlay, and gemstone stay distinct construction materials.
Runes and seam light remain bounded animation hardware rather than generic affinity spectacle.
Workmanship and material quality progress from fingerprints and one scratched rune to sculptural relief and a gemstone heart.
telegraph: One faint seam brightens and its iron band pulls tight.
